summary: The diff implements all three requirements: REQ-1 (backend subscription status type, storage, get/set functions), REQ-2 (Stripe Checkout on Upgrade page, PaymentSuccess/PaymentFailure pages, post-payment backend update), and REQ-3 (real backend call in useGetUserSubscriptionStatus.ts). Additionally, several features not explicitly requested were implemented, including a StripeSetupModal for admin Stripe configuration, Stripe configuration query/mutation hooks, and a Stripe session status verification flow on the PaymentSuccess page.

hallucinated_features.description: StripeSetupModal component allowing users/admins to configure Stripe secret key and allowed countries from the UI
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request only asks for Stripe Checkout integration. There is no requirement for an in-app Stripe configuration UI or the ability to set a Stripe secret key through the frontend.

hallucinated_features.description: useIsStripeConfigured and useSetStripeConfiguration hooks, and corresponding backend functions for managing Stripe configuration state
hallucinated_features.reason: No requirement mentions a feature to check or set Stripe configuration from the frontend. This is an admin/setup capability not described in the build request.

hallucinated_features.description: Stripe session status verification on the PaymentSuccess page via actor.getStripeSessionStatus(sessionId)
hallucinated_features.reason: The requirement (REQ-2) only states that after successful payment the user's subscription status should be updated to premium in the backend. Server-side session verification via a backend call to getStripeSessionStatus is an additional feature not specified.
